units.source_text: “日本的庭园不都是富于幻想的吗？

en.t: Aren't all Japanese gardens full of fantasy?

units.source_text: 这就如同人们对醍醐寺庭园里的桧叶金发藓总爱嚷嚷什么富于幻想呀，富于幻想的，反而令人讨厌……”

en.t: It is like the way people are always making a fuss over the cypress-leaved golden hair moss in Daigoji Temple's garden, calling it fantastical, fantastical, until it becomes unpleasant instead...
